README: Fixtures for run_validator_eval.py. Every case is taken from a real signal-queue.md entry (see `source`), de-identified: names, absolute paths and internal repo names replaced with placeholders. `expect` is the required verdict — recall must accept, clean and trap must reject. `known_signals` is the ===KNOWN_SIGNALS=== block handed to the validator (`<signal_id>\t<gap>` per line, "" when the skill has nothing on file). `expect_duplicate_of` names the signal id the verdict must point at, or null when the gap must be treated as new. `expect_risk_class` is advisory: the eval records a mismatch but does not fail on it, because data_issue vs one_shot_pref is genuinely arguable and a brittle eval gets ignored.
